purpose: Side-by-side UI audit. For each surface in the canonical demo (desktop/docs/demo-pages.html) we record the demo's design vocabulary + key JSX, and the live React surface's equivalent JSX + class drift. ChatGPT (or any reviewer) can use the `delta` arrays per surface to decide what to keep, change, or import.

global_observations: Atmosphere class family was renamed (`atm-*` → `deck-atmosphere-*`) between docs and code. Cheap to reconcile; pick one canonical prefix and run a single search/replace pass.

.eyebrow CSS class is documented but absent in live; every live surface inlines `font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.32em] text-fuchsia` instead. Identical visual output. If we want code brevity, add the .eyebrow utility class to index.css. If we want explicit Tailwind tokens, update demo to drop .eyebrow.

.pill / .pill.is-active is documented but absent in live (count=2). Most surfaces lost the pill control vocabulary and replaced with underlined tabs (schedule), icon rails (earn), or omitted control rows entirely. This is the biggest single source of perceived 'demo is more crafted than live'. Either add a .pill utility or restore pill rows to surfaces where they previously had information (Queue · 5 / Channels · 4 etc.).

.library-card + 4 .lcc-* bracket corners is the dominant card primitive in demo. Live uses .library-card-corner-{tl,tr,bl,br} naming and is consistent (204 usages). Naming alias only — `.lcc` is the shorter demo alias for `.library-card-corner`.

.cockpit-tile + ctc-* brackets is heavily used in live (130 occurrences) but does NOT appear in demo HTML. Either demo is out of date (cockpit-tile is a newer brand primitive), or cockpit-tile is overused in live and should be replaced with library-card on some surfaces (especially schedule queue rows).

Demo headlines use poetic / brand voice ('Mission control' / 'Loadout' / 'Previously loved' / 'The crew' / 'Welcome to the dojo.'). Live tends toward functional voice ('Plan your next post.' / 'Connect and grow.' / 'Sign in to start clipping.'). The poetic voice is on-brand for Liquid Clips and was the locked direction during the v0.6.31 rebrand. Restoring poetic voice across these 5 surfaces is the highest-impact-lowest-risk single pass.

Demo .halo-digit SVG-step-indicator pattern exists only on the Thumbnail surface. Worth preserving as an explicit step-indicator vocabulary if we add other onboarding/wizard flows (e.g. Caption Studio first-run).

Demo .hud-frame marquee strip (yt-references horizontal scroll on thumbnail, sponsored-banner-style on earn) does not appear in live. If we want pre-visualised inspiration carousels (a recurring demo motif), the .hud-frame primitive should be promoted to a reusable component.

instructions_for_reviewer.how_to_use_this_file: For each surface entry, compare `demo` and `live` blocks. Treat `delta` as the candidate change set. instructions_for_reviewer.ship_workflow: design target locked → patch → validate → install → ASK before commit. No commits, no pushes, no tags, no releases without explicit per-turn green-light.
